Class OffscreenWindows

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.script.OffscreenWindows
public final class OffscreenWindows extends Object
Shared window facade for Java, Kotlin, Scala, Groovy and ZenScript. ZenScript imports it as mods.offscreencleanroom.Windows.

Screen and button declarations contain only ordinary data and script callbacks. Native GUI classes are confined to the nested Client implementation and are reached only on a physical client. Each open creates a fresh GuiScreen; buttons use the shared OffscreenButtons helper. Declare screens during setup and open them from client input callbacks. When using ZenScript, load declarations in client startup scripts and restart after editing them.

This facade owns only its own windows and GUI button bindings. It never closes another addon's windows or modifies another addon's button instances. Server-backed inventory containers require a synchronized factory and are not made safe merely by drawing them in a desktop window.

    • buttonOn

      public static OffscreenWindows.Button buttonOn(String guiClass, String text, int x, int y, int width, int height, OffscreenWindows.Screen screen)
      Adds a pop-out button to any GuiScreen class by its full class name, preserving that screen's existing controls. The declaration takes effect immediately. Coordinates use that GUI's normal scaled units.
      Parameters:
      guiClass - fully qualified GuiScreen class name; superclass matches are accepted
      text - visible button label
      x - left edge in GUI units
      y - top edge
      width - positive button width
      height - positive button height
      screen - local screen declaration; each click creates a fresh backing GUI and native window
      Returns:
      appearance configuration for the newly declared button

    • openSynchronized

      public static OffscreenWindows.Window openSynchronized(String factoryName)
      Opens an addon-registered ModularUI OffscreenSimpleFactory through its real server handshake. Register the factory on both sides in the addon; scripts can also declare one with panel(String, String, int, int). Repeated requests reuse this facade's pending handle without taking ownership from another addon.
      Parameters:
      factoryName - exact registered factory name
      Returns:
      owned handle, or null when the normal factory cannot open yet
